value.rationale: Paired predecessor/successor counts are the first local counting fingerprint of a finite strict order. The exact first failure, the unique isomorphism pair at six, the rigid witnesses, and the fact that one more refinement round suffices through six provide an intrinsic sharp cutoff and meaningful information-loss boundary. The witness additionally contradicts a material stronger published net-degree uniqueness assertion under precisely its stated hypotheses, which makes the finite boundary consequential beyond a routine checksum.
